fixedFindings.problem: Aggressive overgrowth used a fixed 64-record SlowTick budget instead of the continuous GlobalQualityWeight mandate.
fixedFindings.fix: Replaced the fixed budget with ResolveOvergrowthScanBudget(), continuously scaled from 8 to 64 checks per lane.

fixedFindings.fix: Added ResolveMatureSporeAcousticScanBudget(), continuously scaling from 8 checks to the serialized ceiling without changing gameplay truth or DTO layout.
